title: The shallow--water limit of linear water waves over a discontinuous bottom
summary: We rigorously justify the zero--dispersion limit of linear water waves over a sharp bottom step, recovering the shallow-water equations as a transmission problem, and describe the localized dispersive effects generated near the discontinuity. To obtain estimates uniform in the shallow-water parameter, we study an abstract functional framework for the linear water waves equations in two-dimensional fluid domains with a Lipschitz curved bottom.
